text:
Great question! Here's what happens with gift orders:

✅ **Price privacy:** No—prices are never printed on gift packing slips, so your sister won't see what you paid.

✅ **Gift message:** Yes! You can add a free printed gift note with up to **200 characters** of your message.

When you place the order, just select the gift option and you'll be able to add your personalized message before checkout. Your sister will receive the plant with your note, but no price information. Perfect for a surprise!

Is there anything else you'd like to know about sending the gift order?
